one_liner: A to-do list that a new user can sign up for and use in under a minute, on phone or desktop.

claims.claim: Tasklet is a to-do list for individuals
claims.quote: Tasklet is a to-do list for people who want one place for their tasks

claims.claim: A new user signs up and adds a first task in under a minute, on a phone or a laptop
claims.quote: sign up and add their first task in under a minute, on a phone or a laptop

claims.claim: Users sign up and log in with an email address and a password
claims.quote: Users sign up and log in with an email address and a password
